project: Say It, See It (WebXR + Three.js r147)
conventions: Every ability uses @ability: <unique_id>, @match: <ar & en patterns>, and @code: or @do:.
Always include both English and Arabic keywords in @match.
Use APP.THREE instead of global THREE inside @ability blocks.
Set instancedMesh.userData.skipMatrixShader = true on InstancedMesh objects so applyDissolveShader never discards them.
Background systems that register APP.onTick(..., null, true) must clean up previous globals on hot-reload.
Do not duplicate @match triggers that already exist in an earlier file in priorityOrder unless updating or removing the duplicate.
